blocks.tamil_translation: is Unique. He is free of need of anyone. (All are in need of Him.) Allah has not begotten (anyone). Nor has He been begotten (by anyone). There is none equal to Him’ — say these words. Then spit three times to your left, and seek protection with Allah Ta'ala from Shaytan the rejected.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالَي: يُؤْذِينِي ابْنُ آدَمَ يَسُبُّ الدَّهْرَ وَأَنَا الدَّهْرُ بِيَدِيِ اْلاَمْرُ أُقَلِّبُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب قول الله تعالي يريدون ان يبدلوا كلام الله، رقم:٧٤٩١
blocks.tamil_translation: “The son of Adam hurts Me by cursing time, yet I am time. In My control are all affairs. I make the night and the day alternate as I will.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates, through the Prophet ﷺ, that Allah Ta'ala said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي اْلاَشْعَرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مَا أَحَدٌ أَصْبَرَ عَلَي أَذًي سَمِعَهُ مِنَ اللهِ يَدَّعُونَ لَهُ الْوَلَدَ ثُمَّ يُعَافِيهِمْ وَيَرْزُقُهُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب قول الله تعالي ان الله هوالرزاق ....، رقم:٧٣٧٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “There is no one more patient than Allah in bearing words that hurt on hearing them. The mushriks (those who associate partners) claim that He has a son. Even then, He gives them good health and fulfils their needs.” Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: لَمَّا خَلَقَ اللهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ
